title: Tumor-Suppressor Genes: Growth Restraints, p53, Rb and the Two-Hit Concept
word_count_method: Unicode lexical tokens from saved p.teaching-prose, with tags removed and common entities decoded. Headings, figure-reference paragraphs, tables, figures, questions, worked examples, revision, references, UI excluded. Visible article excludes SVG/buttons.

matrix: Prerequisites alleles, proliferation, DNA repair; avoid detailed repair chemistry
CDK and E2F concepts; detailed checkpoint integration 4.E.05
Stress-dependent transcription, p21, MDM2; detailed death pathways 4.E.06
Wnt and intestinal homeostasis; no detailed developmental pathway
Allele and marker logic, copy-neutral LOH; no full pedigree course
Dosage, complex formation and genome maintenance; no specialist genomics
syllabus.scope: Detailed tumor-suppressor gene mechanisms and classical inheritance; reserve full checkpoint integration for 4.E.05, apoptosis for 4.E.06, Wnt development and full pedigrees for appropriate units.
